selection_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
 SELECT r.parsed_data->>'series_core' AS series_core, count(*) AS game_count, count(DISTINCT r.raw_value) AS raw_count
 FROM kifu_albums a JOIN kifu_raw_event_values r ON r.raw_value=a.event
 WHERE a.event_id IS NULL AND r.category='unclassified_pending' AND NULLIF(r.parsed_data->>'series_core','') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY r.parsed_data->>'series_core'
), selected AS (
 SELECT *, md5(:seed || E'\n' || series_core) AS selection_hash FROM candidates WHERE game_count=1
 ORDER BY selection_hash, series_core COLLATE "C" LIMIT 30
)
SELECT s.*, r.id AS raw_event_id, r.raw_value, r.parsed_data, a.id AS album_id, a.player_black, a.player_white, a.date_played, a.round_name, a.place, a.source, a.source_path
FROM selected s JOIN kifu_raw_event_values r ON r.parsed_data->>'series_core'=s.series_core
JOIN kifu_albums a ON a.event=r.raw_value AND a.event_id IS NULL
WHERE r.category='unclassified_pending' ORDER BY s.selection_hash, s.series_core COLLATE "C", a.id

stop_reason: Completed 30 preselected cores within 45 minute limit
singleton_definition: Exactly one currently unlinked album among unclassified_pending raw values for a parsed series_core (not one distinct raw spelling)
safe_scope: SAFE means enough evidence for event-type preprocessing candidate. Edition/round fields preserve provenance and do not authorize DB writes; not a full linkage or dedup approval. HOLD means at least one material identity/metadata ambiguity remains.
measurement_limit: Wall clock covers first production selection query through final bundle and focused verification; no per-item stopwatch, so average only.
